run_vit_imagenet: run the ViT parameter prediction and evaluation script on the ImageNet dataset
run_vit_cifar10: run the ViT parameter prediction and evaluation script on the CIFAR-10 dataset
create_ghn2_predictor: create a GHN2 predictor for a given dataset like imagenet or cifar10
build_vit_network: build a Vision Transformer network using the Network class with ViT genotype
load_images: load image data and class count for a dataset using the image_loader function
evaluate_model: evaluate a model on validation images and get top1 and top5 accuracy using infer
check_model_capacity: check the parameter count of a model using the capacity utility function
